candidates.title: Be A Lamp - Norton Hall Band

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: 1 Be a lamp for all my days,
Lord, bear a torch that I might see through the fog
Of bitter pain
And know your purpose lies beneath
O to taste and see the gospel as I never have before
Be your lamb for all my days,
And I shall walk in this jewel

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: As I soldier across this desert
Through the plains of doubtful nights Speak
The words that guide my footsteps
Let them shine a star so bright Point
Me northward to that country
Where my soul will find its home
Be a lamp for all my days and I shall walk
In enemy's draw

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: You're the Lamb, the Light of Heaven,
You're the mercy for all men
Through Your death and resurrection,
Sons of night are born again
What a gift so free and moving,
Sets ablaze my fainting soul
Be a ramble on my days and I shall walk in endless joy. Oh, do taste and see the gospel as I never have before. Be unloved for all my days and I shall walk
In endless joy

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: Oh, to taste and see the gospel as I never have before

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: Be a lamp for all my days And
I shall walk in endless joy
